text:
Halloweentown | J. Paul Zimmerman, Kimberly J. Brown
In this episode of the Disney+ Hulu Throwbacks podcast, hosts Sherry Cola and Cierra Ramirez are doing a deep dive into Halloweentown – the 1998 Disney Channel Original Movie that made the holiday cool. They’re joined by two of the stars of the Halloweentown franchise, Kimberly J. Brown and J. Paul Zimmerman, who played siblings “Marnie” and “Dylan”. Kimberly and J. answer questions about their time on set, test their memory of the most iconic spells, hand out superlatives to their castmates, share the behind-the-scenes stories, including what it was like working with the legendary Debbie Reynolds, and discuss what it means to them that this classic movie has become required viewing by fans every October.
